hypotheses.claim: Current grammar.ebnf is not syntactically aligned with current G9 V3 source constructs: it lacks type-level union syntax and explicit if statements used by the current spec.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The mismatch is an artifact of the proxy EBNF-to-Lark translation rather than the source grammar.
hypotheses.falsifier: A parser generated directly from current grammar.ebnf parses the cited current-source constructs without grammar extension.
hypotheses.action: Patch grammar/parser only; do not redesign ClayCode semantics.

hypotheses.claim: WASI 0.3 Component Model/WIT is a strong first candidate for ClayCode typed FFI/component lowering, while Clay capability authorization remains outside WIT.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A native ABI or WASI 0.2/native hybrid yields lower complexity and better semantic/latency fidelity for the first BASE release.
hypotheses.falsifier: APP-02/APP-04/APP-07 lowering benchmarks show material semantic gaps, excessive adapter complexity, or worse latency/repair cost than alternatives.
evidence: Bytecode Alliance Component Model WIT/world/resource/async documentation (external primary documentation)
hypotheses.action: Do not promote; benchmark in WP-06/WP-07 after parser/IR freeze.
